title: Cedar the Night Train and the Sleepy Valley
description: A pine-green night train carries sleepy passengers through a moonlit valley and hums them all the way to the home station.

Cedar.role: Main character; a small kind night-train engine
Cedar.color: Deep pine green body with a short row of three cream passenger cars and pine-green trim
Cedar.bodyShape: Small rounded engine with three cream cars, no human-like arms or hands
Cedar.face: One round moon-yellow headlamp as a friendly eye-light and a gentle smile on the front
Cedar.wheels: Dark round train wheels that stay the same on every page
Cedar.accessories: One moon-yellow headlamp, cream window glow in the cars, and no extra lights or logos

Hattie.role: Supporting character; the station owl who signals departure once
Hattie.color: Soft gray feathers with a warm amber face
Hattie.bodyShape: Small round owl with wings, not human arms or hands
Hattie.face: Round amber eyes and a calm little beak
Hattie.accessories: One small lantern she lifts once at the station

settingBible.Sleepy Valley: A quiet pine valley with one little station, a high bridge over a silver river, one tiny platform, and a candle-lit home station with a roundhouse
settingBible.passengers: Sleepy passengers in soft cream and blue blankets; one small child in the last car; they stay small, calm, and unnamed
settingBible.visualStyle: Warm polished 3D children's illustration, soft rounded forms, one scene per page, gentle evening-to-night colors, and no readable text

continuityRules: Cedar stays deep pine green with the same moon-yellow headlamp, gentle smile, dark wheels, and exactly three cream passenger cars.
Cedar has no human-like arms or hands.
Hattie is the same soft gray owl with amber eyes and one lantern, and she appears only at the little station.
The ride is a calm night journey with no breakdown, rescue, or repair.
The sky moves from lavender evening to moonlit night, and the valley stays quiet.
Every illustration is one continuous scene with no panels, collage, grid, text, badge, logo, or watermark.

pages.text: Evening sky turned lavender while Cedar the night train waited at the little station.
pages.illustrationScene: Cedar waits at a small valley station as the sky turns lavender, with three cream cars behind his pine-green engine.
pages.continuityNotes: Lock Cedar's pine-green engine, moon-yellow headlamp, smile, dark wheels, and three cream cars.

pages.text: Sleepy passengers climbed on with soft blankets, but no one hurried.
pages.illustrationScene: Sleepy passengers in cream and blue blankets climb calmly aboard Cedar's cream cars at the little station.
pages.continuityNotes: Passengers stay small and unnamed. No rushing. Cedar's design stays locked.

pages.text: Hattie the station owl lifted her lantern once, and Cedar rolled out slowly.
pages.illustrationScene: Hattie the gray owl lifts one lantern on the station perch while Cedar rolls slowly away from the platform.
pages.continuityNotes: Introduce Hattie's gray feathers, amber eyes, and one lantern. Cedar leaves slowly.

pages.text: The wheels sang a quiet click-clack through the pines.
pages.illustrationScene: Cedar rolls through tall dark pines with a soft wheel rhythm and warm cream windows glowing.
pages.continuityNotes: Same three cars and headlamp. Forest is calm, not scary.

pages.text: They passed a farm with one gold window still awake.
pages.illustrationScene: Cedar passes a quiet farmhouse with exactly one gold window lit, seen from the valley track.
pages.continuityNotes: One gold window only. Cedar unchanged.

pages.text: A child in the last car saw the moon keeping up with the train.
pages.illustrationScene: A small child with a cream blanket looks from the last cream car as the moon travels beside Cedar.
pages.continuityNotes: Child is small, unnamed, and stays in the last car. Moon is the same crescent later.

pages.text: Cedar glided over a high bridge above a silver, still river.
pages.illustrationScene: Cedar crosses a high gentle bridge above a silver still river in the moonlit valley.
pages.continuityNotes: Bridge and river are calm. All cars stay on the track.

pages.text: He dimmed his headlamp so the night animals could stay easy and safe.
pages.illustrationScene: Cedar's moon-yellow headlamp glows softer while small night animals rest undisturbed beside the pines.
pages.continuityNotes: Headlamp is dimmer but still the same lamp. Animals are calm background, not a rescue.

pages.text: The cars swayed, and someone hummed along with the wheels.
pages.illustrationScene: Cedar's three cream cars sway gently through the valley while a passenger hums in the warm window light.
pages.continuityNotes: Sway is gentle. Same cars and passengers.

pages.text: A tiny platform appeared, with one bench and one waving paw.
pages.illustrationScene: A tiny platform with one bench appears, and one small paw waves as Cedar approaches.
pages.continuityNotes: One bench and one waving paw only. No stop yet.

pages.text: Cedar stopped for a goodnight wave, then rolled on.
pages.illustrationScene: Cedar pauses at the tiny platform for a goodnight wave, then begins to roll onward.
pages.continuityNotes: Brief calm stop only. Not a breakdown. Then he continues.

pages.text: The valley grew quiet until only the moon and the track remained.
pages.illustrationScene: Cedar follows the moonlit track through a wide quiet valley with no other lights nearby.
pages.continuityNotes: Valley empties to moon and track. Design locked.

pages.text: The home station lights glowed like a row of candles.
pages.illustrationScene: The home station comes into view with a row of candle-like lights as Cedar approaches.
pages.continuityNotes: Home station is distinct from the first little station and the tiny platform.

pages.text: Passengers stepped off yawning, and Cedar's engine sank to a whisper.
pages.illustrationScene: Yawning passengers step off at the home station while Cedar's engine settles quieter.
pages.continuityNotes: Calm arrival. No repair. Engine sound only softens.

pages.text: In the roundhouse, Cedar rested with a soft goodnight, little train.
pages.illustrationScene: Cedar rests inside the roundhouse with his headlamp a small moon-yellow glow and his three cars still.
pages.continuityNotes: Goodnight ending. Cedar keeps every locked feature and rests.
